research_question: Does the proposed offline project evidence journal's local revision history and revision-inclusive export still differ from free Obsidian history plugins?

competitor_evidence.name: Obsidian Time Machine
claimed_features: Visual version rail and side-by-side/colored diff
Restore whole versions or selected paragraphs
Local File Recovery and Git history together
Export Markdown history including diffs or full versions and source metadata
competitor_evidence.commercial_implication: Revision-inclusive readable export and diff are already offered by a community plugin. Do not claim this feature alone is unique or monetizable.
competitor_evidence.limitations: No installation or export quality/recipient testing; plugin requires Obsidian 1.13.0+ per listing.

competitor_evidence.name: Obsidian Local Version History
claimed_features: Fully local note and folder timelines
Pinned versions, restore, deleted/moved file recovery
Folder history and cross-vault change list
competitor_evidence.commercial_implication: Local per-project/folder version tracking and comparison are already covered by a free plugin; project-scope history alone is not a paid reason.
competitor_evidence.limitations: Community plugin listing says pending review; no independent install or reliability validation.

competitor_evidence.name: Obsidian MyHistory
claimed_features: History scoped to all notes or a folder
History survives rename, move and delete
Preview, pin and restore historical versions
competitor_evidence.commercial_implication: Local private, folder-scoped recovery is not a unique paid feature.
competitor_evidence.limitations: Restoration overwrites current note according to author warning; no independent security or QA audit.

competitor_evidence.name: Standard Notes free
claimed_features: Free end-to-end encrypted notes and sync
competitor_evidence.commercial_implication: Offline privacy, tags and export do not differentiate a paid product. Paid history exists in its Productivity plan.
competitor_evidence.limitations: Vendor advertised pricing $90/year Productivity, $120/year Professional; no transaction verification.

eliminated_claims: Export of note history in readable Markdown
Offline operation, no account, tags, basic export
revised_competitive_gap.remaining_hypothesis: A guided human handover workflow that requires explicit event/reason attribution, assembles a recipient-oriented revision-and-context dossier, and validates the recipient's comprehension could reduce task time compared with free plugins. This is NOT proven.
revised_competitive_gap.why_pay_statement: NOT PROVEN: free Obsidian history plugins now overlap with both local revision tracking and history export.

controlled_validation_matrix.task: Capture a project event with human-entered reason and evidence reference
compare: Obsidian Local Version History plus template

controlled_validation_matrix.task: Hand off 3 notes with 2 prior revisions each and a readable chronological explanation
compare: Obsidian Time Machine Markdown history export
measure: recipient time to identify change reason

controlled_validation_matrix.task: Recover one revision without silently overwriting unrelated current content

pass_requirements: At least two measured advantages over a realistic free workflow
At least one documented competitor complaint addressed in observed usability testing
Five buyer interviews and ten dated Store review links
One-sentence credible paid reason and independently re-scored rubric >=80
1024x768 bilingual Windows GUI and safe recovery tests
provenance: Desk research based on Obsidian plugin catalog and Standard Notes official vendor descriptions on 2026-10-31. Claims were not independently installed or QA tested. No customer interviews, Store review sample or sales evidence. This supplement does not replace the parent rubric and must not be interpreted as MARKET_FIT_PASS.
